svg.text: Test tools: serving a model for the author's measurements (gate 3)

deploy/, not part of peresearch (any provider the gateway speaks to is). The laptop runs a small model of the same family with the Modal flags; Docker rebuilds the Modal image before any GPU time is paid for. working tree on 5ca550a, 2026-10-12.
starts the server, then peresearch chat
stops it on quit, SIGHUP, SIGTERM
FLAGS and ENV read from modal_vllm.py (ast)
ZetokRAG models move to the CPU
environment: CUDA of nvcc = CUDA of torch
download: HF with the image's settings
serve: through vllm_server.py, as on Modal
sampling: requests sent as the agent sends
tool call: 1 of 3 requests calls the tool
vLLM's whole log, compiled kernels noted
test and replica must pass first
no GPU billed for the download
max 1 container, scale to zero after 300 s
proxy auth (Modal's default) as the API key
working tree on 5ca550a, 2026-10-12; their state is kept in STATUS.md
the endpoint is the user's, through its provider's protocol (Chat
Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, Gemini Interactions);
checked with small models on Ollama 0.32.15, llama.cpp and vLLM
0.29 (2026-10-06, recorded in tests/data/servers); LM Studio and the
cloud APIs only against recorded or SDK-shaped fixtures
